name: super-productivity
description: Lets Claude read your Super Productivity tasks or add tasks to your Inbox, limited to the permissions you grant in the app.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Super Productivity desktop app running on this computer (Settings → Misc → Enable assistant access). The app decides what Claude may do: read task summaries, also read notes, and/or add tasks to the Inbox. This extension only relays messages to http://127.0.0.1:3876/mcp; it stores no data. Super Productivity must be running.

access_key.title: Access key
access_key.description: Generate it in Super Productivity: Settings → Misc → Assistant access → Generate access key.
